ios.desc:
BorgLens brings the power of Borg Backup Solution straight to your iOS device, offering seamless access to your backup archives anytime, anywhere. With this app, you can securely browse your Borg Backup repository, list archives, view files within specific backups, and safely download individual files directly to your device — all with full security and control, right on your device. Once downloaded, files will be accessible offline and integrated smoothly with the Files app.

Compatibility: Support Borg stable version 1.x.

## Features

- Access Borg remote backup securely via SSH using public/private key authentication, directly from your device (BorgLens only requires read access, no change to your remote backup repository).
- Seamlessly integrated downloaded backup files with the Files app.
- View the archives in a remote backup.
- View and search for files within an archive.
- Download files from an archive in a remote backup.
- View details of remote backup repository (e.g., last backup time, disk usage, chunks etc.).
- View details of a remote backup archive (e.g., files, disk usage, backup command etc.).

## Terms of Use

This app follows the standard Apple Terms of Use (EULA), available at: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

## Privacy

BorgLens stores all data encrypted and solely on the device, utilizing the operating system's built-in data protection mechanisms. Repository-related data, such as repository URL, passphrase, and SSH keys, are further encrypted and securely stored in the device's Keychain, ensuring maximum security and privacy.

We are fully committed to data security and privacy. High lights about our privacy practice:

* We don’t track your usage of the app, there are no cookies, advertisements, analytics.
* We design our app to be used anonymously, we do not ask any email, phone or personal information to use our app.
* We do not (and will never) sell or share any of the data submitted directly or indirectly by our users with any person or entity.

## Technical Support

If you encounter any issues while using the app, have feedback to share, or wish to request a feature, please contact us via email support within the app. We will respond to your inquiry promptly.
